::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
A genuinely new DRAM mega-fab, separate from CXMT's Hefei headquarters site, entering substantive construction in March 2026 — this tracker did not capture it in an earlier pass, and it is one of the single largest individual under-construction projects in this entire dataset. Planned monthly capacity of 400,000-600,000 wafers would be 2-3x CXMT's existing Hefei output.
:::

**Chinese name:** 长鑫存储上海基地 (Chángxīn Cúnchǔ Shànghǎi Jīdì)

## What does this facility make?

High-end DDR5 and LPDDR5X DRAM, plus a dedicated HBM3 line (50,000 wafers/month of the planned total) aimed at AI compute, server, and automotive-grade demand.

## Why does it matter?

If completed on the stated schedule, this single fab would roughly double CXMT's total DRAM capacity and push the company further up the global DRAM ranking — concrete evidence that the 'many fabs under construction' reality in China is larger than a facility-by-facility reading of status fields that lag real-time news can capture without active, repeated rechecking.
